section_summary.extract_value: This section introduces 'Study 4', which investigates the discriminant validity of the Creativity Achievement Questionnaire (CAQ) against potential confounding variables: IQ and self-enhancing bias. The study aimed to test the CAQ against IQ scores in two samples of students with mean IQ levels above 120, addressing the debate on the IQ-creativity correlation at higher intelligence levels. Additionally, the Marlowe-Crowne Social Desirability Scale (MCSD) was administered to account for self-enhancing bias in participant responses.
